0.title: How a blueprint runs
0.body: The engine doesn't pull data "backwards": it starts at the trigger and runs one node at a time, following the arrows. Each node publishes outputs ('{{'t.userId'}}') that the following ones read. Named ports branch; every port needs an arrow and everything ends at End.

1.title: Add the trigger
1.body: Drag Saved an event (wishlist.itemAdded) onto the canvas. In the inspector, fill dedupeKey with saved-24h:'{{'t.eventId'}}':'{{'t.userId'}}'.
1.checklist: The wishlist.itemAdded node exists and dedupeKey is filled in.
1.hint: dedupeKey prevents two runs for the same user/event pair.

2.title: Wait 24 hours
2.body: Drag Wait (core.delay), connect the trigger to it and set duration = 24h (use 2m to test in the lab).
2.checklist: Node added, t→d edge connected, and a valid duration.
2.hint: It's "Wait", not "Wait until": you want 24h after the save, not before the event.

3.title: Still saved?
3.body: Drag Still saved?, connect it after Wait, fill userId = '{{'t.userId'}}' and eventId = '{{'t.eventId'}}' through the variable picker.
3.checklist: Node added, edge connected, and both fields referencing the trigger.
3.hint: The picker only shows what's above it in the line; userId comes from the trigger (t), not from Wait.

4.title: Has a ticket?
4.body: Drag Has ticket? and fill the same two fields. If they bought in the last 24h, there's no point reminding them.
4.checklist: Node added, edge connected, and both fields referencing the trigger.

5.title: Event data
5.body: Drag Event by id, eventId = '{{'t.eventId'}}'. It publishes title, slug, status and date — public data only.
5.checklist: Node added, edge connected, and eventId referencing the trigger.

6.title: Decide
6.body: Drag Condition, connect it after Event by id and build: '{{'s.saved'}}' = true and '{{'a.hasAccess'}}' = false and '{{'e.status'}}' = PUBLISHED and '{{'e.startsAt'}}' > now.
6.checklist: Node added, edge connected, and the four rules built.
6.hint: The condition has two ports: if true and if false. Both need an arrow.

7.title: Notify and end it
7.body: Drag In-app notification connected on if true: recipient '{{'t.userId'}}', title Still thinking about '{{'e.title'}}'?, link /events/'{{'e.slug'}}'. Connect the notification to an End, and if false to another End.
7.checklist: Notification filled in, connected on if true to an End, and if false connected to another End.
7.hint: A port with no arrow is a Validate error (PORT_EDGES). Connect "if false" to an End.

8.title: Validate, publish, activate
8.body: Click Validate (0 problems), Publish and Activate. To watch it run, save an event with another user and follow it in Recent runs: the run stays waiting with "wakes up in 24h".
8.checklist: Analysis with no errors and the version published (and activated, when applicable).
8.hint: Validate flagged problems; click each one to jump to the node.

findEvent.q: I bought a ticket. Where do I find my event?
findEvent.a: Everything you have access to lives in "My list": live events appear at the top, followed by upcoming events and available replays. You also get the link by email after the purchase.

venueTicket.q: Does a venue ticket include the stream?
venueTicket.a: Not necessarily. Venue tickets grant entry to the event location. If the event is also streamed, you will see the "LIVE + REPLAY" tag on your list — in that case the same ticket unlocks both.

cameraAngles.q: Can I watch from several camera angles?
cameraAngles.a: Yes. On multi-camera events the player shows a side panel with every available camera. You can switch angle at any time, or turn on grid mode to watch several cameras at once.

streamDown.q: The stream froze or went off air. What should I do?
streamDown.a: First check your connection and reload the page. Quality adapts to your internet automatically. Drops on the event side are announced in the player itself, and the missed stretch stays available in the replay.

replayWindow.q: How long does the replay stay available?
replayWindow.a: The availability window is stated on each event page. While watching you can pause and use the progress bar to jump back to any moment.

replayAngles.q: Does the replay have the same camera angles as the live stream?
replayAngles.a: Yes. Every angle broadcast live is also available in the replay, with the same navigation between cameras.

devices.q: How many devices can I watch on?
devices.a: You can sign in on several devices. To see and end open sessions, go to Account settings — from there you can disconnect any device you do not recognise.

refund.q: How do I request a refund?
refund.a: Contact support using the button at the bottom of this page, telling us the event and the email used for the purchase. Our team confirms the conditions and, once approved, the refund follows your card issuer timeline.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data showon.io processes, why, who we share it with and how you exercise your rights under the Brazilian data protection law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018).

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller of the data processed on the platform is [RAZÃO SOCIAL], registered under CNPJ [CNPJ], with offices at [ENDEREÇO].

dataWeCollect.title: Data we process
dataWeCollect.account: Account and identification: display name, email, password (stored only as a hash), phone, tax ID (CPF or CNPJ) when required for invoicing, country, bio, profile picture and the age bracket you declare for ad personalisation. With Google or Apple sign-in we store your identifier at those providers and, for Apple, a token used only to revoke access when you delete your account.
dataWeCollect.session: Session and security: every login stores the IP address, the browser or app identification (user-agent), creation, last-use and expiry dates, and a hash of the session token. We use it to keep you signed in, end sessions and investigate abuse.
dataWeCollect.payments: Payments and orders: your Stripe customer identifier, Google Play purchase tokens, order items, amounts, coupon used and the origin of the visit (campaign parameters and referring site). Full card details are handled by the payment provider and never reach our servers.
dataWeCollect.fiscal: Invoicing: the payer's name, email and tax ID, plus the invoice XML and PDF kept in file storage.
dataWeCollect.streaming: Stream usage: viewing records per session and camera (start, last signal and duration), playback progress, camera switches and player quality reports.
dataWeCollect.chat: Live chat: messages sent, the author's display name, timestamp, moderator deletions and mutes.
dataWeCollect.communications: Communications: notifications sent and read, the device push token with platform, app version and language, your notification preferences, the delivery status of email campaigns, who you follow and your wishlist.
dataWeCollect.analytics: Browsing behaviour (non-essential): pages and events viewed, searches, likes, cart items, ad clicks and player events, with a session identifier and device type. From these events we derive an interest profile (affinity by category, organiser and artist, price range, completion rate and purchase propensity) used to recommend events.
dataWeCollect.cookies: Cookies and local storage: authentication cookies (httpOnly) and a cookie holding your cart; in your browser we keep a cached profile, your consent choice, the analytics session identifier and the first-visit campaign parameters.

legalBases.title: Legal bases
legalBases.contract: Performance of the contract (Art. 7, V): account, ticket purchase and delivery, streaming, chat, service notifications and support.
legalBases.legalObligation: Legal and regulatory obligation (Art. 7, II): issuing invoices and keeping the financial and access records required by law.
legalBases.consent: Consent (Art. 7, I): non-essential behaviour events, the recommendation profile and marketing emails. You grant and withdraw it at any time without losing access to the service.
legalBases.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX): security, fraud and abuse prevention, aggregate audience measurement and product improvement, always limited to what is necessary.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.intro: We share data only with those who need it to run the service:
sharing.payments: Stripe (card and wallet payments): email, name and user identifier. Google Play (in-app Android purchases): purchase tokens.
sharing.fiscal: PlugNotas (Brazilian service invoices): the payer's name, email and tax ID, amount and service description.
sharing.auth: Google and Apple (social sign-in): only what is needed to authenticate and identify your account.
sharing.push: Expo (push notification delivery): the device token and the notification content.
sharing.infra: Infrastructure: hosting and database (DigitalOcean), site delivery (Vercel), S3-compatible file storage and the video CDN (Bunny), which carries the media without receiving account data.
sharing.observability: Grafana Cloud (monitoring): application logs that may contain internal user identifiers, used to diagnose failures.
sharing.noSale: We do not sell personal data and we do not use your data to train artificial intelligence models.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Some of these providers process data outside Brazil, mainly in the United States and the European Union. In those cases the transfer relies on the grounds in Art. 33 of the LGPD, with contractual clauses and equivalent security safeguards.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.analytics: Behaviour events and the interest profile: deleted automatically after 180 days.
retention.sessions: Sessions: until they expire or are revoked. Email verification and password reset tokens expire quickly and are stored only as hashes.
retention.account: Account: for as long as it exists. On deletion we end the sessions, revoke social sign-in and the account becomes unusable, but the record stays flagged as deleted for as long as legal obligations and fraud prevention require.
retention.orders: Orders, payments and invoices: kept for the applicable tax and accounting periods, even after the account is deleted.

rights.title: Your rights (Art. 18)
rights.body: You may confirm processing, access, correct, port and delete data, withdraw consent and object to processing based on legitimate interest. Export, usage-history deletion and consent controls live in
rights.response: Requests sent to the data protection officer are answered within 15 days.

deletion.title: What deletion removes
deletion.body: Deleting usage data removes behaviour events, the recommendation profile and viewing records. Deleting the account ends sessions, revokes social sign-in and disables notifications, but does not remove orders, payments and invoices, which are retained by legal obligation.

consent.title: Consent
consent.body: On your first visit you choose whether to accept non-essential data. The choice is stored in your browser and, if you have an account, on the server as well, and can be changed at any time in Settings → Privacy. Declining does not affect purchases, event access or support.

minors.title: Children and teenagers
minors.body: The platform is intended for people aged 16 or over. Under-16s may only use it with the specific, prominent consent of a parent or legal guardian, who is responsible for the account. If we find an account without that consent, we delete the data.

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords are stored only as hashes, tokens are hashed or encrypted, traffic is served over HTTPS and internal access to data is restricted to those who need it. No system is infallible: in a relevant incident we notify you and the Brazilian authority (ANPD), as required by Art. 48.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: When this policy changes we update the date at the top and, for relevant changes, tell you by email or inside the platform.

dpo.title: Data protection officer
dpo.body: Questions, requests and complaints about your data:

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.p1: By purchasing a ticket you acquire the access rights described on the event page — live stream, replay, additional cameras or in-person entry, according to the ticket you chose.
terms.p2: Access is personal and non-transferable. Sharing credentials or redistributing the stream ends your access with no refund.
terms.p3: Dates, times and replay availability are set by the event organizer and may change; we notify you by notification and email when that happens.
terms.p4: Refunds follow the conditions stated on the event page and applicable law. Contact support through the Help Center.
terms.p5: You must be 16 or older to create an account. Under-16s may only use the platform with the consent of a legal guardian, who is responsible for the account.
terms.p6: Your personal data is processed under our Privacy Policy, including what we keep after account deletion to meet legal obligations.

replay.label: REPLAY
replay.title: Replay that respects real time.
replay.text: The recording is born together with the stream. The timeline covers the full broadcast, start to finish: anyone who missed the start can jump back to the right moment.
replay.viewer: Watch later, at your own pace, with the same cameras from the broadcast.
replay.organizer: Sell the replay as a separate ticket and keep earning after the event ends.

tickets.label: TICKETS
tickets.title: One ticket, two worlds.
tickets.text: Digital for those watching from home, in-person with a QR code for those attending the venue. Same sale, same report, same team checking people in from their phone.
tickets.viewer: Buy from the browser, no install needed, and get in with a tap.
tickets.organizer: No cap on digital capacity. Coupons, free events, collaboration between organizations.

audiences.label: WHO IT'S FOR
audiences.title: If it happens live, it fits here.

shows.title: Concerts and festivals.
shows.text: Multiple cameras on stage and in the crowd, replay sold afterward.

sports.title: Sports and leagues.
sports.text: Low latency, a channel with the whole season, one camera per court.

talks.title: Conferences and talks.
talks.text: Multiple audio tracks for language or narration, a Libras (Brazilian Sign Language) window.

worship.title: Church services and celebrations.
worship.text: Weekly recurring schedule, free or with contributions.

theater.title: Theater and dance.
theater.text: In-person and digital tickets for the same session.

classes.title: Classes and workshops.
classes.text: Automatic recording becomes an on-demand library.

steps.title: Buy the ticket.
steps.text: Credit or debit card, right in the browser. The ticket stays in your account.

steps.title: Watch with control.
steps.text: Camera, audio, and full screen are your choices. On computer or on phone.

steps.title: Rewatch whenever you want.
steps.text: Replay with the full broadcast timeline, with the same cameras.

proof.label: WHO'S ALREADY STREAMING
proof.title: Events that have already happened here.

team.label: WHO MAKES IT
team.title: Made in Brazil for live events.
team.text: showon.io is built by a small team that builds its own streaming infrastructure: ingest, multiple cameras, packaging, replay, and delivery. No reselling a third-party player. When something needs to get better, we change the code.

cta.title: On the side of watching, or of making it happen?

viewer.title: I want to watch.
viewer.text: See what's live now and what's coming up.

organizer.title: I want to organize.
organizer.text: Stream, sell, and get paid all in one place.
